verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents RESTful endpoints, SDKs and a metadata API, but nothing in the evidence offers a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec of the API itself. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The metadata API describes modules and fields, which is an adjacent feature, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
